properties.name: A cue is one named kind of message in reflow2's interface: a few declared types, in one consistent place in every reply, ranked and kept within a budget
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "We can keep (c) with (d) now, then (a)" (option a of the open question on cues, after c and d)
properties.statement: A cue is one declared kind of message in reflow2's interface with a few types (the next call, a lesson, a related record, owed work), carried in one consistent place in every reply, ranked, and kept within a budget so more cues never mean each one is read less. What exists today under other names (hints, lessons at the step, debt on reads, near-matches) is brought under it. It follows the side-of-the-agent cues and the counting, so the counts say which cues earn their place first.
